reason: Conversation 1 correctly identified the small clean pool of sump water as normal seal-wetting behaviour, asked the one sensible qualifying question (amount and cleanliness), and reassured the homeowner with clear criteria for when to worry, matching the ground truth exactly. Conversation 2 never diagnosed anything: it ignored the customer's repeated direct question, pushed an unjustified fault-finding sequence (filter, drain pump impeller, drain hose, sink spigot blanking plug, drain cycle) on a two-week-old machine that was draining its tub fine, repeated boilerplate safety warnings about 'several litres' escaping from a cupful of water, and ended by looping the same drain-test instruction twice without ever stating the water is normal or that no part or escalation is needed.
